base_member_text: [L82-L85,L188-L191] (MED/MPI error scope) A communicator-local argument error aborts MPI_COMM_WORLD rather than the passed communicator, unexpectedly terminating unrelated communicator participants.
audit_member_text: [L82-L85,L188-L191] (MED/communicator-scope) A root-contract violation aborts MPI_COMM_WORLD rather than the communicator supplied by the caller.

base_member_text: [L295,L338,L391,L421] (HIGH/build dependency) Four active MPI routines include genmpi_distr.inc or genmpi_coll.inc, but neither include file is present anywhere in the supplied source tree, so compiling this implementation with USEMPI would fail unless the build injects undocumented external files.
audit_member_text: [L295,L338,L391,L421] (HIGH/build-completeness) All matrix distribution and collection implementations depend on genmpi_distr.inc and genmpi_coll.inc, but neither include exists under source_code.

base_member_text: [L79-L145,L185-L250,L583-L606] (LOW/unchecked MPI status) MPI return codes are repeatedly assigned to ier/ierror but never checked, leaving datatype, collective, or point-to-point failures without local diagnostic handling.
audit_member_text: [L79-L145,L185-L250,L582-L606] (MED/mpi/error-handling) MPI return codes from communicator, datatype, collective, point-to-point, and free operations are never checked.
[L67-L137] (MED/bounds-contract) Vector distribution creates subarray datatypes from unchecked is/lm metadata and destination extent, permitting invalid starts or subsizes.

[L173-L243] (MED/shape-contract) Block-vector distribution independently uses size(a,2) for send types and size(b,2) for receive types without verifying equality, so sender and receiver type signatures can disagree.
[L428-L471] (HIGH/arithmetic-input-contract) decomp divides and takes modulo by numprocs without rejecting zero and does not validate myid.
[L521-L563] (MED/output-bounds) det_submatrices assumes output arrays have at least mp*np elements and dimensions exceed the fixed four-cell overlap without validating either condition.
[L567-L606] (MED/minimum-extent) Border shifting indexes second and penultimate rows/columns and uses ma-2 counts without checking minimum matrix dimensions.
